blurb: Compact British gundog nicknamed the Merry Spaniel for its ever-wagging tail
description: The English Cocker Spaniel is a compact British gundog with long low-set ears, a silky coat in many colors and a friendly, cheerful, people-loving nature.
answer: The English Cocker Spaniel is a British gun dog originally used to flush woodcock and other game toward the guns. It is a sturdy, compact dog standing about 38 to 41 cm tall and weighing around 13 to 15 kg. It is commonly described as active, good-natured and friendly, earning the nickname Merry Spaniel.

body: Spaniel-type dogs have appeared in English art and literature for almost 500 years. Until the mid-19th century land spaniels were sorted mainly by weight, and Cockers and Springers could come from the same litter. When the Kennel Club published its first stud books in 1874, any spaniel under 25 lb went into the Cocker pool. The breed is the foundation of the American Cocker Spaniel, and the AKC gave the English Cocker separate breed status in 1946. It has won Best in Show at Crufts seven times, more than any other breed.

The English Cocker is sturdy, compact and well balanced, with dark eyes and lobular ears that reach just past the nose. Solid colors include black, liver and red or golden, and there are many parti-colors, including blue, liver, orange and lemon roans. Working or field-bred lines have shorter coats and less pendulous ears than show-bred dogs, and the two strains are rarely crossed.

The breed is described as friendly and happiest around people rather than left alone in a yard. With early socialization it is said to get on well with children and other pets. Cockers can be stressed by loud noises or rough handling and respond best to kind, reward-based training. Stanley Coren ranked the breed 18th for working intelligence.

As an active sporting breed, the English Cocker is generally expected to need regular exercise, and working lines are again popular as hunting dogs. Show-bred dogs carry a longer coat and ears that benefit from regular grooming.

Conditions reported in the breed include periodontal disease, ear infections (otitis externa), obesity, anal sac impaction, chronic hepatitis and progressive rod-cone degeneration, an inherited eye disease. A 2024 UK study found a life expectancy of 13.3 years, and a 2024 Italian study found 13 years.

faq.q: What is the difference between an English and an American Cocker Spaniel?
faq.a: The American Cocker was developed from the English Cocker and is smaller, with a shorter snout. The two have been registered as separate breeds since the 1930s and 1940s.

faq.q: How long do English Cocker Spaniels live?
faq.a: A 2024 UK study found a life expectancy of 13.3 years, and a 2024 Italian study found 13 years.

faq.q: Are English Cocker Spaniels good with children?
faq.a: With good early socialization they are said to get along well with people, children, other dogs and other pets.

faq.q: Is the English Cocker Spaniel recognized by the FCI?
faq.a: Yes. The FCI lists it as breed number 5 in Group 8.
